crossRefs.note: God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?
Remember your congregation, which you purchased of old, which you have redeemed to be the tribe of your inheritance…
Don’t deliver the soul of your dove to wild beasts. Don’t forget the life of your poor forever.
Now therefore, if you will indeed obey my voice, and keep my covenant, then you shall be my own possession from among…
and you shall be to me a kingdom of priests, and a holy nation.’ These are the words which you shall speak to the…
They assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said to them, “You take too much on yourself…
not as lording it over those entrusted to you, but making yourselves examples to the flock.
You shall answer and say before Yahweh your God, “My father was a Syrian ready to perish. He went down into Egypt, and…
and he has brought us into this place, and has given us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey.
Now, behold, I have brought the first of the fruit of the ground, which you, Yahweh, have given me.” You shall set it…
When the Most High gave to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the children of men, he set the bounds of…
He raises up the poor out of the dust. He lifts up the needy from the dunghill to make them sit with princes and…
who gives rain on the earth, and sends waters on the fields;
so that he sets up on high those who are low, those who mourn are exalted to safety.
the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the…
He has filled the hungry with good things. He has sent the rich away empty.

translations.web: Your congregation lived therein. You, God, prepared your goodness for the poor.
translations.bsb: Your flock settled therein; O God, from Your bounty You provided for the poor.
translations.kjv: Thy congregation hath dwelt therein: thou, O God, hast prepared of thy goodness for the poor.
translations.asv: Thy congregation dwelt therein: Thou, O God, didst prepare of thy goodness for the poor.
